overview: Raya and the Last Dragon is a 2021 American animated fantasy action comedy film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios. It was directed by Don Hall and Carlos López Estrada, and written by Qui Nguyen and Adele Lim, and stars the voices of Kelly Marie Tran, Awkwafina, Izaac Wang, Gemma Chan, Daniel Dae Kim, and Benedict Wong. The film's plot follows the warrior princess Raya (Tran) as she seeks the fabled last dragon, Sisu (Awkwafina), to save her father (Kim) and the land of Kumandra from evil spirits that are known as Druun.
